dialogue.origin: 本日はご相談いただきありがとうございます。どのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.content: Thank you for reaching out for a consultation today. What would you like to discuss?

dialogue.origin: このコロナで、いろんな事が、ギクシャクして困っています
dialogue.content: With this whole coronavirus situation, a lot of things have become strained, and it's troubling me.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、なかなか思い通りにいかないですね。
dialogue.content: I understand—things really haven't been going the way we would like.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです
dialogue.content: Exactly.

dialogue.origin: よろしければ詳しくお教えいただきますか？
dialogue.content: If you're comfortable, could you please tell me more about it?

dialogue.origin: 私は医療関係に勤めているのですが、
dialogue.content: I work in the medical field,

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そこでも毎日大変なんですけど、
dialogue.content: It's tough there every day, but...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Mm-hm.

dialogue.origin: 夫は夫で、仕事が減って、自宅待機が増えて大変だし、
dialogue.content: My husband, for his part, has had his work reduced and is on standby at home more often, which is also difficult,

dialogue.origin: 本当にくたびれます
dialogue.content: It's truly exhausting.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、それは困るし不安定で心配になりますよね。
dialogue.content: I can imagine. That must be difficult and the instability must be worrying.

dialogue.origin: おまけに
dialogue.content: On top of that,

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 同居の義母は元気なのはいいんですが、
dialogue.content: My mother-in-law, who lives with us, is healthy, which is a good thing, but...

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 高速のパーキングエリアに勤めてて、それも気になってるんです
dialogue.content: She works at a highway service area, and that's also been worrying me.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、夫さんのことに加えお義母さんのこともご心配なんですね。
dialogue.content: I see—so in addition to your husband, you're also concerned about your mother-in-law.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: お義母さんについてご心配を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: Could you tell me more about your concerns regarding your mother-in-law?

dialogue.origin: パーキングは、いろんなとこからどんな人と接してるかわからなくて、義母のことが心配なのは勿論だけど、
dialogue.content: At the service area, you don't know what kind of people she's interacting with or where they're from. Of course, I'm worried about her, but...

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 何しろ私は医療関係勤務なので、辞めて欲しいな、って思ってるんですけど、
dialogue.content: Since I work in healthcare, I really wish she would quit, but...

dialogue.origin: 義母はとても強い人で、聞く耳なんか持ってくれないんです
dialogue.content: my mother-in-law is very strong-willed and just won't listen.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。感染などではずいぶんご心配ですよね、
dialogue.content: I understand. You must be quite worried about infection and things like that.

dialogue.origin: それは本当に何より防がなきゃいけないので。
dialogue.content: That's something we absolutely have to prevent, more than anything.

dialogue.origin: あなたが医療の知識をお持ちですので、なおさらご心配になられますよね。
dialogue.content: Since you have medical knowledge, I imagine you're even more concerned.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです。夫も、思ったようには気をつけてくれなくて…
dialogue.content: That's right. My husband doesn't take precautions as much as I'd like...

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、大切なご家族への感染を防ぐことが第一ですものね。
dialogue.content: I see. Preventing infection among your precious family is the top priority, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: それもあるけど、病院クラスターは絶対に出せません
dialogue.content: That's part of it, but we absolutely cannot have a cluster at the hospital.

dialogue.origin: ほんとですね、お仕事柄責任がありますね。
dialogue.content: Absolutely—you have a great deal of responsibility given your line of work.

dialogue.origin: それなのに、毎日口酸っぱく言っても、
dialogue.content: And yet, even though I keep telling them every day until I'm blue in the face,

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: なかなか聞き入れてはもらえません
dialogue.content: they just won't listen.

dialogue.origin: 毎日のことですからずいぶんご苦労がありますね。
dialogue.content: Dealing with this every day must be very taxing.

dialogue.origin: 本当に毎日イライラしてます
dialogue.content: I'm just so frustrated every single day.

dialogue.origin: あなたはお仕事もして、ご家族のことも守らないと思っておられ、気が休まりませんね。
dialogue.content: You're working and feel you must protect your family too, so you can't catch a break.

dialogue.origin: 頭に来てるし、もはや、家族守るっていうより、自分や病院を守りたいです
dialogue.content: I'm fed up, and at this point it's less about protecting my family and more about wanting to protect myself and the hospital.

dialogue.origin: 勝手にしろ！！って言っても始まらないし…
dialogue.content: But just telling them "Do whatever you want!" won't solve anything...

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: いつも言葉がけをされているのですね。
dialogue.content: It sounds like you're always trying to talk to them about it.

dialogue.origin: 夫におかあさんに言って貰ったけど糠に釘！
dialogue.content: I had my husband talk to his mother, but it was like talking to a brick wall!

dialogue.origin: 本人も意識低いし
dialogue.content: He himself isn't very conscious of the risks either.

dialogue.origin: ますます神経質になってしまいます
dialogue.content: It just makes me more and more anxious.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、お義母さんは聴くお気持ちがないように見え
dialogue.content: I see. It seems your mother-in-law isn't willing to listen,

dialogue.origin: あなたの毎日のご苦労がとても伝わってきました。
dialogue.content: and I can really sense how much you struggle day in and day out.

dialogue.origin: 最近は、
dialogue.content: Lately...

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Yes?

dialogue.origin: 娘が再開した学校に行きたがらなくなって、、、
dialogue.content: My daughter has started refusing to go to school, which has reopened...

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 本当に困ってます
dialogue.content: I'm really at a loss.

dialogue.origin: あなたのご心配が伝わってきます。
dialogue.content: I can feel how concerned you are.

dialogue.origin: ちなみに家族構成を教えていただけますでしょうか？
dialogue.content: By the way, could you tell me about your family composition?

dialogue.origin: 4人家族です。義母は、夫が小さい時に亡くなってます
dialogue.content: We are a family of four. My mother-in-law passed away when my husband was little.

dialogue.origin: 義父"の間違いです
dialogue.content: I meant father-in-law—that was a mistake.

dialogue.origin: すみません
dialogue.content: I'm sorry.

dialogue.origin: 教えていただいてありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you for letting me know.

dialogue.origin: 少し整理をさせていただきますね
dialogue.content: Let me summarize a bit.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 四人家族でいらっしゃり、夫さんは在宅のお仕事が増え収入が減りご心配、お義母さんはとても元気だが
dialogue.content: So, you are a family of four. You're worried because your husband is working from home more and his income has decreased. Your mother-in-law is very healthy, but...

dialogue.origin: 感染にはとても意識が低いので、いくら言っても聞いてもらえず腹が立つ上にあなたは疲れてしまわれている。
dialogue.content: she has very low awareness about infection, and no matter how much you say, she won't listen, which is frustrating and has left you exhausted.

dialogue.origin: 娘さんは学校に行くことに消極的で心配になっている。あなたは医療のお仕事をされているため
dialogue.content: Your daughter is reluctant to go to school, which is another concern. And because you work in the medical field...

dialogue.origin: ご家族のご心配やお仕事に影響などが出ないようにとても気を使われる日々でいらっしゃる
dialogue.content: you spend your days being extremely careful to avoid any impact on your family or your work.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: では今後ご心配が少なくなるようにご一緒に考えさせてください。
dialogue.content: Then, let's think together about how we can reduce your worries going forward.

dialogue.origin: お願いします
dialogue.content: Yes, please.

dialogue.origin: 一番のご心配はどのことでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Which is your biggest concern?

dialogue.origin: 順番に取り組んでいきましょう
dialogue.content: Let's address them one by one.

dialogue.origin: 自分でも混乱してどうしたらいいか分からなくなってます
dialogue.content: I'm confused myself and don't know what to do anymore.

dialogue.origin: 娘が
dialogue.content: My daughter...

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 学校に行かないのも、私が神経質になってるせいじやないかと、自己嫌悪にも陥ります
dialogue.content: Her not going to school... I wonder if it's because I'm being so anxious, and I'm starting to feel self-loathing.

dialogue.origin: 何から手をつけていいか、わかりません
dialogue.content: I don't know where to start.

dialogue.origin: そう思ってご自分を責めてしまわれるのも無理はないように思います
dialogue.content: It's understandable that you would think that and end up blaming yourself.

dialogue.origin: でもそれはあなたがご家族を大切にされてるからこそ、です。
dialogue.content: But that's precisely because you care deeply about your family.

dialogue.origin: そうでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Do you think so?

dialogue.origin: はい、
dialogue.content: Yes,

dialogue.origin: あなたはお仕事もして、家族のことを見守り、行動されています。
dialogue.content: you are working, looking out for your family, and taking action.

dialogue.origin: 一日の限られた時間をすべて家族のために使われているように思えますよ
dialogue.content: It seems to me you’re using all of your limited time each day for your family.

dialogue.origin: そうでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Do you think so?

dialogue.origin: はい、
dialogue.content: Yes,

dialogue.origin: あなたのお気持ちのすべてが行動に表れていると感じます
dialogue.content: I feel that all of your feelings are reflected in your actions.

dialogue.origin: イライラして当たってばかりいるから？
dialogue.content: Is it because I'm always getting frustrated and lashing out at them?

dialogue.origin: とんでもないです
dialogue.content: Not at all.

dialogue.origin: あなたの一日の家事や行動やお言葉には家族を思う気持ちがこもっていると感じます。
dialogue.content: I feel that your daily chores, actions, and words are filled with care for your family.

dialogue.origin: どんなところに？
dialogue.content: In what ways?

dialogue.origin: お義母さんにご注意をされるのは家族の感染を考えてのことであるし
dialogue.content: When you caution your mother-in-law, it's because you're thinking about preventing infection in the family,

dialogue.origin: 強くおっしゃることは必要なことです。
dialogue.content: and it's necessary to speak firmly.

dialogue.origin: 安全確保のためですから
dialogue.content: It's for everyone's safety.

dialogue.origin: だけど、彼らの行動は変わっていないと思うんです
dialogue.content: But I don't think their behavior has changed.

dialogue.origin: その行動を夫さん娘さんお義母さんは見ておられますよ
dialogue.content: Your husband, daughter, and mother-in-law are all seeing your actions.

dialogue.origin: だから、やっぱり学校に行かなくなったのかな？
dialogue.content: So is that why she stopped going to school after all?

dialogue.origin: とんでもないです、わかっていてもできないことばかりなんです。
dialogue.content: Not at all. There are many things that are hard to do even when we understand them.

dialogue.origin: 気持ちがこもっていると感じていても、家族だからという甘えなどもあるのではないかと私は感じます。
dialogue.content: Even when they feel the care behind it, I imagine there may also be some taking-things-for-granted that comes from being family.

dialogue.origin: あなたはよくされています、今大変な社会現象ですが
dialogue.content: You are doing a great job. This is a difficult societal situation right now, but...

dialogue.origin: 大変さをあなたは一番よく感じて家族のために行動されています。
dialogue.content: you are the one who feels the difficulty most keenly and are acting for the sake of your family.

dialogue.origin: 今のあなたを続けていただきたいと思います。
dialogue.content: I would like you to continue being who you are now.

dialogue.origin: 大変でしょうがあなたらしくすごしていただきたいと思います。
dialogue.content: It must be hard, but I hope you can live in a way that feels true to yourself.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: あなたのお体が何より心配です。
dialogue.content: I am most concerned about your own well-being.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそありがとうございました。お時間になりました。失礼します。
dialogue.content: Thank you as well. Our time is up. Take care.

topic.sub: 義母とのコミュニケーション問題
